:::{#thm-rb-unbiased}
#### Rao--Blackwellizing preserves unbiasedness

If $\hparam$ is an [unbiased](estimation.qmd#def-unbiased) estimator of $\param$
and $\statf{\vX}$ is a [sufficient](#def-sufficient) statistic for $\param$,
then $\condE{\hparam}{\statf{\vX}}$ is also unbiased for $\param$.
:::

::: proof

We use the [law of iterated expectations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-lie):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{\condE{\hparam}{\statf{\vX}}}
&= \E{\hparam}
&& \text{(law of iterated expectations)}\\
&= \param
&& \text{($\hparam$ is unbiased)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
